verdict.rationale: Devin's own docs explicitly recommend running multiple Devins in parallel on independent tasks. The API can create sessions programmatically, which gives a direct way to launch many tasks. However, parallelism is documented only as a single guideline line, with no detail on concurrency limits, orchestration, or monitoring at scale, and no hands-on corroboration of throughput gains. Missing for 10: documented concurrency limits/scale, fleet-level orchestration and monitoring of parallel sessions, independent or hands-on evidence of throughput at scale.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can run many agent tasks concurrently to scale delivery throughput
